title: Frost and Freeze Warning
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers.
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs
| where outdoor_temp_c<3
| stats min(outdoor_temp_c) as low_temp, latest(_time) as when by date_mday
| eval when=strftime(when,"%F %T")
| sort - when
description: Warns when your weather station reports temperatures approaching freezing so you can protect plants, pipes, and the car windscreen.
value: A local frost warning is more accurate than a regional forecast; acting the night before saves tender plants and burst pipes.
implementation: Ingest weather-station temperature; schedule each evening and alert when a frost is likely overnight.
visualization: Table of frost nights with the low temperature reached.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you when it is about to freeze so you can cover plants and protect pipes before the cold hits.
